title: Closure under sequential race
statement: For every pair of Boolean predicates $M_1,M_2$ and natural numbers $a,k$, if the verifiers associated to both predicates are efficient in the model, then the verifier that applies $M_1$ to the first $a(|x|+1)^k$ bits of $r$, returns true if that accepts, and otherwise applies $M_2$ to the remaining suffix and returns false if that accepts (returning no answer if it does not) is efficient in the model.
hypotheses_covered: The verifiers associated to $M_1$ and $M_2$ are efficient
